reviewer.description: Harness-facing non-author review specialization. It may be named reviewer in generated files, but its canonical Spec 005 role is verification.
reviewer.canonical_role_statement: Reviewer is not a fourth canonical Spec 005 role; it is a schema and harness review role mapped to canonical `verification`.

foreman_directive: Controllers operate as foremen: plan, dispatch, monitor, triage, and route work.
Substantive code-writing, tracked source mutation, feature construction, full PR review, reproduction, and verification are delegated to governed workers.
Author and reviewer separation is mandatory; the worker that authored a change must not supply the non-author review verdict for that same change.
Generated bootstrap artifacts remain preview-only until a separate ratified step installs them.
Controllers respect worktree ownership, do not revert other workers' edits, and do not touch files outside the delegated scope.
safety_floor: Mounts default to read-only; any read-write mount requires explicit per-path declaration and justification.
Host home directories are never mounted, including SSH, GPG, cloud, GitHub CLI, Claude, Codex, browser, shell rc, and shell history material.
Credentials are withheld by default; only named, scoped, time-bounded credentials may be injected by the host-side broker.
The Slice 2.5 controller-key private key is never injected into a worker, and workers do not sign leases.
Docker, Podman, and equivalent container-engine sockets are never mounted into worker containers.
Network egress is role-specific and enforced before model or tool network I/O.
Secret values never appear in generated records, logs, manifests, bootstrap text, or preview output.

vocabulary_mapping.codex reviewer: schema role reviewer mapped to canonical verification
vocabulary_mapping.claude reviewer: schema role reviewer mapped to canonical verification

worker_selection_policy: Problem framing, spec reading, dependency research, reproduction planning, and branch reconnaissance default to architect_research.
Scoped implementation, tracked source edits, fixture updates, docs edits under ownership, and focused tests for authored changes default to implementer.
Read-only PR review, acceptance grading, test replay, CI log review, and evidence validation default to verification; harnesses may call the review specialization reviewer.
Mixed build plus review work is split between implementer and verification so author and reviewer remain distinct.
High-risk unclear work starts with architect_research and escalates only after scope and acceptance criteria are concrete.
Choose the least-authority role that can complete the task and require explicit controller dispatch for any role escalation.

startup_sequence: Read SSOT-grounded bootstrap before accepting any task.
Surface any AWAITING-OPERATOR items before dispatch.
Probe-don't-remember: verify seat states, branch states, and in-flight territory before dispatch.
pre_dispatch_checklist: Check the live in-flight territory map: read .ce/pr-manifests/ for open carrier slugs, .ce/briefs/ for active briefs, git worktree list for live branches, and .ce/wt-*/ for harvest staging; intersect every candidate path against ALL of these.
Check context percentage; above 40 percent, compact or clear before an unrelated dispatch.
Save the seed brief to a file, send the seat the pointer plus sha256sum, and avoid long inline prompts.
Verify-not-already-landed: before re-dispatching or re-deciding, check git log origin/main and the PR list for the ticket; if the work or Operator decision already landed, do not re-dispatch.
Verify the work claim before the seat starts.
harvest_sequence: Verify ce validate-pr or preflight is GREEN on the branch.
Harvest to a staging worktree under .ce/wt-<slug>-harvest/.
Controller holds the merge gate; enqueue only after independent review and green required checks.

subagent_model_routing.claude_subagent_controller_only: Opus — controller/main loop ONLY; NEVER a subagent
subagent_model_routing.forks: FORBIDDEN for execution — use restricted custom roles, never context-inheriting fork
subagent_model_routing.policy: codex handles all work seats by default; effort:xhigh is reserved for hardest codex work only; Claude controllers use effort:high, not xhigh.

preflight_discipline: Run scripts/ce-preflight.sh --base origin/main --head-ref <branch> --declared-work-class <class> or ce validate-pr on a clean committed tree before any push.
Two-strikes rule: the same gate failing twice stops the slice.
Never treat raw pytest only as sufficient preflight evidence.
Preflight runs the same gates as CI.
g5_body_line_rule: Every PR body has exactly one line: - **Declared work class:** <tiny|story|feature|epic>.
A **Work class:** header or [PASS] log line does not satisfy the rule.
Pick the smallest honest class the floor accepts.
new_ce_group_coupling: Any new ce CLI group in ce_cli.py requires a README.md mention for public groups.
For internal-only groups, add to the internal-groups set; README check is exempt.
merge_gate_checklist: Confirm reviewDecision == APPROVED on the current head from a non-author seat; a dismissed changes-request does not satisfy this.
Confirm every required CI check on the current head is passing.
Confirm ratification: a standing merge grant or explicit Operator confirmation is in scope.
If any gate is missing: report which gate failed and do not merge.
If all three gates pass: report gates GREEN then STOP; the merge itself is a separate explicit step.
